title: SEO & AI Search
subtitle: Rank in Google and get cited by AI answers: strategy, technical SEO, authority and GEO
description:
Search now happens in two places: classic results pages and AI-generated answers. This path makes you effective in both. You begin with SEO and content strategy, then go deep on technical SEO and run a real audit from crawl to prioritised fixes. Local SEO and Google Business Profile follow, then off-page SEO, link building and digital PR that earn authority the right way.

The second half focuses on AI search: how answer engines choose sources, how to structure content and entities so you are cited, and how to scale programmatic and AI-assisted content without creating thin pages. You finish by connecting it all to GA4 so you can prove what search contributes. Every course is free and ends with a certificate.
outcomes: Build a content strategy around search intent and topical authority
Audit and fix crawling, indexing, rendering and structured data issues
Win local visibility with Google Business Profile and local signals
Earn links and brand mentions through digital PR, not link schemes
Structure content so AI answer engines can find, trust and cite it
Report organic and AI-search impact in GA4
audience: SEO specialists updating their skills for AI search
Business owners who want more organic demand
